name: 読書中に開く階層付き操作メニュー
prompt:
Create one Japanese catalog candidate for LH05-0173. Image 1 is the current native Japanese component and is the layout/copy authority; image 2 is the original Apple Books menu and is the source-state reference. Preserve the 390×280 compact menu and its exact content: “目次・0％” with the ≡ glyph; “本の中を検索” with ⌕; “テーマと設定” with あ; the four actions “共有”, “縦固定”, “並べ方”, “しおり”; and “622ページ中の1ページ”. Keep the current hierarchy, row order, pill sizes, spacing, and Meiryo roles (14px/24px main rows, 20px/28px symbols, 12px/16px lower actions and page count). Do not add the reading page or extra icons from outside the current component preview.
Use the current Lighthouse design guidance: pure white canvas and surfaces, neutral borders, no mint wash or tinted surface. Make only the active Contents row use the official forest gradient, exactly linear-gradient(135deg, #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%), with white text and glyph. Make the Search Book, Themes & Settings, and four lower actions white with restrained neutral-gray borders, dark text, and supporting glyphs in neutral slate #526173. Keep the page count quiet and readable in gray. No shadows, glow, gradients on secondary controls, or colored wash. Preserve all Japanese text exactly and output the same compact aspect ratio as image 1.
reviewNotes: Active contents row uses the official forest gradient; secondary actions are white with neutral borders and no mint wash; owner review pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
